map.TDS 低就一定好喝吗？: Does a low TDS always mean good taste?
map.TDS 反映溶解固体总量，过低口感平淡、过高有异味；饮用水 300–600 mg: TDS reflects the total dissolved solids; too low tastes flat, too high gives an off-flavour. Drinking water commonly sits at 300-600 mg/L, and what matters is that harmful substances stay within limits.
